# clavis secrets set

<p class="cli-lead">Create or update a secret (VALUE omitted prompts, - reads stdin)</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis secrets set KEY [VALUE] [flags]
```

</div>

Create or update a secret. Leave out `VALUE` to type it at a hidden
prompt (it stays out of your shell history), or pass `-` to read it from
standard input.

## Examples

<p class="cli-example-title">Prompt for the value</p>

```sh
clavis secrets set DATABASE_URL
```

<p class="cli-example-title">From a file</p>

```sh
clavis secrets set TLS_KEY - < key.pem
```

<p class="cli-example-title">A plain variable with a change note</p>

```sh
clavis secrets set FEATURE_FLAG true --kind variable --message "enable beta"
```

</dl>

## Details

Kinds: `secret` (masked, audited reads), `variable` (non-sensitive
config) and `file` (written to a temporary file by `clavis run --mount`).
Writing to production asks you to confirm; pass `--yes` in scripts.
